name: wallet-workload-ahead
description: The wallet workload's ahead step (preset ahead: ahead:auto ahead:raw; rig/WALLET-WORKLOAD.md): the wallet node A, on this role's jar, is cut from the miner M (base jar) and from B; M signs a payment to A whose outputs carry A's height + 1 and it goes to A's pool directly; A's wallet then spends that unconfirmed box, by its own selection (auto) and as inputsRaw (raw); healed, every node must end on one chain. PASS = A accepts its own wallet's transaction, every output is at or above the highest input creation height (txMonotonicHeight), one state root. Before/after for ergoplatform/ergo#2901 (issue #1921): outputs built at the wallet node's own height fall below the unconfirmed input on the base.
